text:
Jenna - AE: FYI got a SIG from AcroTek dropped in the sales SIG inbox. POC target next week, can we assign an owner and fast-track answers?
Tom - Solutions: I can pick this up unless someone else needs it. Quick Q: does the POC require dedicated GPUs or will hosted suffice? Sales mentioned 2x A10.
Maria - InfoSec: Tagging for triage. @Tom checklist for InfoSec review: confirm data classification, export controls, encryption model, and IR contacts. We'll need CAIQ subset answers for network/auth/incident response. ETA 48h after owner has draft.
Jenna - AE: Also asking for a ballpark POC cost for sales — 2 GPUs for 3 days + storage/egress. Need something to put on the SOW.
Ravi - ProdOps: Rough ops estimate: ~$2.2k/day for 2x A10 pool + ops support for short POC. That assumes standard S3 egress; any cross-region or customer-managed KMS will change that.
Tom - Solutions: Putting a quick checklist in thread:
```
- assign owner
- gather CAIQ/SIG doc
- confirm VPC/KMS options
- estimate cost + ops
- reply to customer
```
I'll populate CAIQ answers and tag @Maria for final review.
SecurityBot: New intake ticket created: SR-4821, provisional owner Tom.
Maria - InfoSec: I'll review the draft CAIQ tonight. Heads up: customer specifically requests encryption key ownership. We support KMS and customer-managed keys for Private deployments, otherwise platform KMS for Hosted. That will affect timeline.
Jenna - AE: Customer wants to start Mon 05/13. We need pricing + CAIQ answers by Fri EOD to keep schedule. Can we commit?
Ravi - ProdOps: If we sign off by Fri, we can provision a dev pool by Mon. If they insist on customer-managed keys or strict residency, add ~1-2 weeks for legal and ops changes.
Tom - Solutions: I'll draft a response with provisional pricing and the KMS caveat. Can someone drop the CAIQ file here?
Jenna - AE: Adding the customer CAIQ PDF link in case you need the raw file: https://files.example.com/acrotek/sig.pdf
Ben - Legal: Note: if they require data residency + DPA amendments, legal will need 3 business days to review the change. Also watch for indemnity clauses in the SOW.
Maria - InfoSec: Quick question: do we want to ask the customer to send a condensed CAIQ (top controls) to speed things up, or just work the full SIG?
Jenna - AE: They sent the full SIG. Can we request a condensed Q&A summary to speed review?
Maria - InfoSec: Yes request condensed focusing on top 20 controls. We'll still proceed with full if they push back.
Tom - Solutions: OK I'll own until handoff to InfoSec. Current status: owner=Tom, next deliverable = CAIQ draft + pricing by Fri 17:00. Any objections?
Everyone: :thumbsup:
Jenna - AE: Thanks team — I'll update the customer that we have an owner and an ETA.
